note: Example data: an invented online booking software company selling to an invented clinic group, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The public signals are invented too.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "roi-business-case-builder" skill. Build the business case for Tallowmere Physio moving their 4 clinics to our Business plan. Priya, their practice manager, needs to take it to their finance director. Use the numbers from my discovery notes below, show a range, and give me the spreadsheet.

seller.product: online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, studios and personal trainers
what_changes_for_the_buyer: patients book online 24/7 instead of calling
automatic SMS reminders 24 h and 2 h before each visit
the current scheduling tool is retired

discovery_notes: Front desk is stretched; the buyer is weighing a part-time front-desk hire in January.
Patients complain they can only book during opening hours.

buyer_numbers.source: Priya Raman (Practice manager), discovery call on 2026-10-21; overtime and margin confirmed by email on 2026-10-23

values.input: Appointments booked per month, all clinics
Share of bookings made by phone
Front-desk minutes per phone booking, callbacks included
Front-desk overtime hours paid per month
No-show slots refilled today from the waitlist
Contribution margin per visit, after clinician pay
After-hours calls to voicemail per month
Month the current tool can stop (2-month notice)

seller_numbers.input: Business plan per clinic per month
SMS cost per reminder (passed through at cost)
Reminders sent per appointment (24 h and 2 h before)
Setup and data import, one time

assumptions.input: Phone bookings that move to online booking
assumptions.detail: Clinic customers in their first 6 months (n = 46): 25th percentile 25%, median 40%, 75th percentile 55%.

assumptions.input: Share of saved front-desk time that is really freed
assumptions.detail: No data: part of the saved minutes disappears into gaps between calls. Wide range on purpose.

assumptions.input: Relative cut in no-shows from automatic reminders
assumptions.detail: Clinic customers with no reminders before switching (n = 19), no-show rate 3 months before vs 3 months after: 25th percentile 20%, median 30%, 75th percentile 40%.

assumptions.input: After-hours voicemail callers who book online instead and would otherwise be lost
assumptions.detail: The buyer does not know how many voicemail callers never call back. Wide range; ask the buyer to count them for 2 weeks.

ramp.input: Adoption ramp, months 1 to 3 (share of full use)
ramp.detail: Online-booking use in months 1 to 3 at the same 46 clinic customers: 25th percentile 15%, 35%, 60%; median 25%, 50%, 75%; 75th percentile 40%, 70%, 90%. All reached full use by month 4.

buyer_sees_spreadsheet: yes: Priya will share the spreadsheet with the finance director
seller_internal_notes: Discount authority up to 10% on the plan if signed by 2026-12-15 (internal, not offered yet).

public_signals.target: Tallowmere Physio (verified page, ads link to tallowmerephysio.example)

connectors.dataforseo: not used (the seller sells software, not marketing services)
